name: GENM
recent: Genting Malaysia 近期进行股份回购，并有一项清盘/接管相关公告。公司于2026年8月20日发布季度业绩，营收同比增长32.0%，但净利润同比下降88.6%。新闻方面，母公司 Genting 集团进行供股，并面临信用评级展望负面及债务偿还压力。
notable: 公司进行股份回购（2026年9月17日及10月12日公告）。
公司发布截至2026年6月30日止季度的业绩。
母公司 Genting 集团进行供股，并计划将部分资金用于利息及融资成本。
risks: 公司有一项清盘/接管/限制令/特别管理人相关公告（2026年9月11日）。
RAM Ratings 确认 Genting 集团 AA1 评级但展望负面。
新闻提及 Genting 面临债务偿还及可能需出售非核心资产以避免信用评级下调。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日止季度，营收为38.533亿令吉，环比增长34.4%，同比增长32.0%；净利润为4740万令吉，同比下降88.6%，净利润率为1.2%。

recent_en: Genting Malaysia recently conducted share buybacks and made a winding-up/receivership related announcement. The company released quarterly results on 20 Aug 2026, with revenue up 32.0% YoY but net income down 88.6% YoY. In the news, parent Genting group undertook a rights issue and faces negative rating outlook and debt repayment pressure.
notable_en: The company conducted share buybacks (announced on 17 Sep and 12 Oct 2026).
The company released quarterly results for the period ended 30 June 2026.
Parent Genting group undertook a rights issue and plans to use part of the proceeds for interest and financing costs.
risks_en: The company made a winding-up/receivership/restraining order/special administrator related announcement (11 Sep 2026).
RAM Ratings affirmed Genting Group's AA1 rating with a negative outlook.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM3,853.3 million, up 34.4% QoQ and 32.0% YoY; net income was RM47.4 million, down 88.6% YoY, with a net margin of 1.2%.
